name.ja: HGUC 1/144 BHC専用エコプラ グフ
name.en: HGUC 1/144 BHC exclusive eco plug gouf

ja: ●「機動戦士ガンダム」に登場する機体をエコプラでキット化
●各関節に新型ポリキャップを使用し、可動範囲、強度を拡大
●ヒートロッドは軟質素材星で2タイプ付属
en: ●The aircraft that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam" is made into a kit using Ecopla.
●Uses new polycaps for each joint to expand range of motion and strength
-Two types of heat rods are included with soft material stars.
